hints.title: Zero Stripping
hints.text: For each integer, remove all occurrences of the digit zero from its decimal representation.

hints.title: Canonical Representation
hints.text: Parse the resulting digit string back into an integer value.

hints.title: Uniqueness Set
hints.text: Insert each normalized value into a hash set to collect distinct elements.

hints.title: Reference Implementation

variables: MaxVal: maximum magnitude of an element
complexity.notes: Digit filtering followed by hash set deduplication.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing all pairs for zero-stripped equivalence takes quadratic O(N^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory for the uniqueness set.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use hash set to track deduplicated values after digit normalization.
